title: 图表说明文的结构
goal: 区分引入、概述与细节，并选择概括主要特征的句子。

points.label: 区分引入、概述与细节的功能
选出概括主要特征的概述句

cards.title: 结构
rows: 改写图表主题，保留对象、时间和单位。
The graph shows the number of museum visits, in thousands, from 2010 to 2020.
概括两项主要特征，具体数值留给细节。
Overall, visits to North rose, while visits to South fell.
用代表数据支持一组特征。
用可比较的数据支持另一组特征。

cards.title: 常用表达
rows: The graph shows visits to two museums between 2010 and 2020.
The figures are given in thousands of visits.
Overall, North increased whereas South decreased.
North rose from 10,000 to 30,000, while South fell from 30,000 to 10,000.

body.box:
The line graph compares the number of loans made by two community libraries from 2010 to 2020. Figures are given in thousands. Describe the main features and make relevant comparisons. The lines show the figures at the beginning, middle and end of the period.
Loans (thousands)
30 | E               W
   |  \             /
20 |        X
   |  /             \ 
10 | W               E
   +-------------------
     2010    2015    2020  Year
E = East; W = West; X = both
East: 30, 20, 10; West: 10, 20, 30

The graph compares the numbers of loans, in thousands, made by two community libraries between 2010 and 2020. Overall, loans at East fell, whereas those at West rose. The two figures were equal halfway through the period. East began at 30,000 loans and fell to 20,000 in 2015, before reaching 10,000 in 2020. By contrast, West started at 10,000, rose to 20,000 in 2015 and ended at 30,000. The initial gap therefore reversed by the end of the period.

body.p: 第一句交代对象、时间和单位。概述指出两馆趋势相反，中点时数值相等。后面的数据支持这两项特征。图表没有给出借阅量变化的原因，范文也不写原因。

cards.title: 常见错误
rows: 数据没有说明变化原因。
删去 because the library improved its services。
用 compares the numbers of loans 改写图表主题。
用 loans at East fell, whereas those at West rose 概括趋势。
细节逐个列出数字，两条线之间没有比较。
把两馆相反的起点和终点放在一起比较。

items.stem: A graph shows visits to East and West libraries from 2010 to 2020, in thousands. Which sentence introduces the graph?
options: The graph compares library visits, in thousands, between 2010 and 2020.
Overall, visits to both libraries changed between 2010 and 2020.
East recorded 30,000 visits in 2010 and 10,000 in 2020.
West gained visits because it improved its services in 2020.
items.why: 题干给出对象、时间和单位。第一项在引入中保留这三项信息。

items.stem: East loans fell from 30,000 to 10,000, while West loans rose from 10,000 to 30,000. Which overview captures both trends?
options: East and West both recorded 10,000 loans at the start.
Loans at East fell overall, whereas those at West rose.
East and West both recorded 30,000 loans at the end.
Loans at East rose overall, whereas those at West fell.
items.why: East 从 30,000 降至 10,000，West 反向变化。第二项概括两种趋势。

items.stem: An overview says that two lines were equal in 2015. Which detail supports it?
options: One line rose from 10 to 30 over the period.
One line fell from 30 to 10 over the period.
Both lines stood at 20 in the middle year.
Both lines reached 30 in different years.
items.why: 2015 是中间年份。第三项说两条线当年都是 20，支持数值相等的概述。

items.stem: A graph gives visitor numbers but no reasons. Which sentence adds an unsupported cause?
options: Visits rose from 10,000 to 30,000 over the period.
Visits stood at 20,000 in the middle of the period.
Visits were higher at the end than at the start.
Visits rose because the museum reduced its prices.
items.why: 题干只给出人数，没有提供原因。第四项加入了降价的推测。

groups.text: A graph shows two town pools' annual admissions in thousands. Elm: 2010, 10; 2015, 20; 2020, 30. Oak: 2010, 25; 2015, 20; 2020, 15.

items.stem: Which overview captures the main trends?
options: Both pools increased throughout the period.
Elm rose overall while Oak declined overall.
Elm declined overall while Oak rose overall.
Both pools declined throughout the period.
items.why: Elm 从 10 升至 30，Oak 从 25 降至 15。第二项概括两条线的方向。

items.stem: Which detail supports a statement that the pools were equal midway?
options: Elm had 10,000 admissions at the start.
Oak had 15,000 admissions at the end.
Each pool had 20,000 admissions in 2015.
Elm had 30,000 admissions at the end.
items.why: 两个游泳池 2015 年都是 20,000 人次。第三项支持中点相等。

groups.text:
The graph shows the annual number of theatre tickets sold at two venues from 2012 to 2020. Sales are measured in thousands of tickets. The values shown are for the first, middle and final years of the period. Identify the main features and compare the two venues.
Tickets (thousands)
30 | H               J
   |  \             /
20 |        X
   |  /             \ 
10 | J               H
   +-------------------
     2012    2016    2020  Year
H = Hall; J = Junction; X = both
Hall: 30, 20, 10; Junction: 10, 20, 30

items.stem: Which introduction retains the subject, period and unit?
options: The graph compares ticket sales at two venues, in thousands, from 2012 to 2020.
The graph compares ticket prices at two venues, in pounds, from 2012 to 2020.
The graph compares ticket sales at two venues, in thousands, from 2002 to 2010.
The graph compares annual ticket sales at two venues, measured in single tickets.
items.why: 图表记录两场馆 2012 至 2020 年的售票量，单位为千张。第一项保留三项信息。

items.stem: Which overview describes the main movements?
options: Both venues sold fewer tickets overall, with equal sales at the start.
Hall sales fell overall, while Junction sales rose and the figures met.
Hall sales rose overall, while Junction sales fell and the figures met.
Both venues sold more tickets overall, with equal sales at the end.
items.why: Hall 从 30 降至 10，Junction 从 10 升至 30，2016 年均为 20。第二项概括这些关系。

groups.text:
The graph compares the weight of material collected from two recycling routes between 2005 and 2015. The figures are shown in tonnes for three points in the period. Summarise the main features and include comparisons between the routes where the data provide a basis.
Weight (tonnes)
40 | R-------R-------R
30 |
20 | S-------S-------S
   +-------------------
     2005    2010    2015  Year
R = River: 40, 40, 40; S = Summit: 20, 20, 20

options: Both routes increased, with River remaining higher.
Both routes decreased, with Summit remaining higher.
Both routes remained stable, with River consistently higher.
Both routes remained stable, with Summit consistently higher.
items.why: River 始终为 40 吨，Summit 始终为 20 吨。第三项概括稳定和高低关系。

items.stem: Which detail supports the claim that Summit remained stable?
options: Summit rose from 20 tonnes to 40 tonnes.
River remained at 40 tonnes in all three years.
River fell from 40 tonnes to 20 tonnes.
Summit recorded 20 tonnes in all three years.
items.why: Summit 在三个时点均为 20 吨。第四项用代表数据支持稳定的概述。

items.stem: The graph compares the numbers of two products sold from 2010 to 2020. Complete an introductory sentence.
items.why: compares 是谓语，between 2010 and 2020 表示时间范围。

items.stem: A graph shows figures in thousands of journeys. Complete the unit statement.
items.why: are given in thousands of journeys 说明图中数值的单位。

items.stem: North rises overall while South declines. Complete the overview.
items.why: North rose 与 South declined 分别对应上升和下降。while 连接两项特征。

items.stem: Both series are stable, and the first is higher throughout. Complete the overview.
items.why: remained stable 概括两组稳定，consistently higher 表示第一组始终较高。
